\begin{table*}[t]\centering\caption{Assumptions, calibrated details and deviations (high impact).}\label{tab:dev}
\begin{tabular}{p{0.7cm}p{1.2cm}p{4.8cm}p{9.0cm}}\toprule ID & Paper & Issue & Our decision \\\midrule
A5 & Sec 3.4 & Spline y=S(x) fails for vertical turns & IMPLEMENTED: parametric natural cubic spline, chord-length parameter, own solver \\
A6 & Eq 11 & Missing boundary conditions; duplicated S'' line & IMPLEMENTED: natural boundary; second line read as S' continuity \\
A10 & Sec 4 & Exact maps, start/goal coordinates & RESOLVED: reconstructed from Figs 3, 8-11; optimal lengths match published values on all 4 maps \\
A11 & Sec 4 & Turn / turn-angle definition & Turn = heading change at a vertex; angle = sum of |delta heading|. Confirmed by exact baseline matches (e.g. 1215 deg / 27 turns) \\
A12 & Sec 4 & Timing protocol, hardware, whether plotting is included & Median of 30 runs, search + post-processing only, no plotting \\
A14 & Sec 4 & Whether pruning/smoothing applied to baselines & Paper: VNS-BA$^*$ only. We add an ablation applying it to all \\
A16 & Sec 2 & Diagonal move rule near obstacle corners & Corner cutting allowed (diagonal blocked only if target cell is an obstacle) - confirmed by optimal-length match; strict rule contradicts published lengths \\
A17 & Sec 4 & Multiple runs / statistics not provided & 30 seeded random maps per size, 20\% density, start (0,0), goal (n-1,n-1), solvability enforced \\
A24 & Sec 2/4 & Heuristic of the traditional A$^*$ and BA$^*$ & CALIBRATED: Manhattan - reproduces published length and turns of A$^*$ and BA$^*$ on all 4 maps \\
A25 & Sec 4 & Meaning of 'Number of Nodes' & CALIBRATED: all generated nodes (open + closed); expanded-only is 40-70\% too low \\
A26 & Fig 4 & Exact meeting test & CALIBRATED: node just closed by one side is already closed by the other; reproduces BA$^*$ nodes +-1 \\
\bottomrule\end{tabular}\end{table*}
